summary: Iteration 47 – Purchase List perm-delete/undelete flow + opening-stock Mongo cache. Backend: 25/25 tests pass in ~17s (4 new perm+cache + 14 feature regression + 3 bugfix-45 + 4 seasonal). Verified: POST /purchase-list/item-state {perm_removed:true} sets row.perm_removed=true (row remains in /purchase-list payload for the frontend to filter); GET /purchase-list/deleted-items lists it; POST /purchase-list/refresh does NOT clear perm_removed (only clears temp_removed); {perm_removed:false} restores; non-admin (TEST_EXEC) gets 403 on /purchase-list/deleted-items. Opening cache: purchase_opening_cache collection has doc with fingerprint + entries; after wiping ALL purchase_list_snapshots the subsequent GET /purchase-list returns 296 rows quickly and the opening-cache doc's computed_at is unchanged (opening not recomputed). Frontend (admin/admin123 on /purchase-list): a simple CLICK on a row opens the item dialog (no drag needed); dialog shows pl-temp-delete-btn and pl-perm-delete-btn; Remove temporarily hides the row, Refresh restores it; Delete permanently hides the row, Refresh does NOT restore it, pl-deleted-list-btn opens pl-deleted-dialog listing the deleted item, pl-undelete-btn-{i} restores it to the main table. Regression: green checkbox click on row does NOT open the item dialog (stopPropagation working), Seasonal dialog still works and lists GOBI PAYAL 60-122 with Jul/Aug/Sep. Cleanup: no items left temp_removed / perm_removed / green. GOBI PAYAL 60-122 preserved seasonal [7,8,9] purview RAJESH.

Not a bug per current spec (perm_removed alone drives the deleted-items list and frontend filter), but could be normalized on write.
